integrity: Analytical proof and a reproducible standard-library checker are provided. Finite tests are not substituted for proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact algebraic result for a three-dimensional real SPD matrix, a single off-diagonal perturbation and one recycled eigenvector; spectral condition number, not finite-step PCG error; historical-priority search is not exhaustive.
title: Exact spectral-scaling crossover under a single off-diagonal perturbation
